vedic_reference.note: Devapriya is a modern Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words देव (Deva, God) and प्रिय (Priya, Lover or Beloved). It is a name that signifies being a lover or devotee of God.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Devapriya" reflects the deep reverence and connection to the divine in Hindu culture. It honors the belief in the power and presence of gods in daily life, emphasizing their role in bringing joy and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name "Devapriya" signifies devotion and surrender to the divine. It symbolizes the idea of seeking divine pleasure and happiness above all worldly desires, highlighting the ultimate goal of spiritual growth and self-realization.

historical_references.reference: The name Devapriya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deva' meaning god and 'Priya' meaning dear or beloved. It is believed that this name was given to individuals who were considered to be the beloved of the gods.
historical_references.context: The name Devapriya was commonly used during the period of Hindu dynasties like the Guptas and the Pallavas.

historical_references.reference: The name Devapriya is also associated with the Hindu god Vishnu. In some Puranic texts, there is a reference to a sage named Devapriya who was a devotee of Vishnu and was blessed with divine grace.
historical_references.context: The name Devapriya was also used as a personal name for individuals who were devoted to the god Vishnu.
